principles: Diagnostics must reflect existing gate facts without changing pass/fail semantics.
Operator recovery should be explicit: stale item, reason, next command.
Current local review assurance must stay distinct from future server-backed proof work.
drivers: B-997b closure showed default-run output can hide submitted custom runs.
Voluntary local 3x2 evidence should be visible even when escalation is not required.
Stale material guidance needs to reduce repeated manual diagnosis.

options.name: A: Add read-only summaries and runbook text around existing evaluators
pros: Can be covered by focused smoke tests
cons: Does not add new completion capability
Still depends on operators submitting fresh verdicts correctly

options.name: B: Change DONE/review assurance gate predicates to consume voluntary rounds differently
pros: Could make closure stricter in one implementation pass
cons: Out of scope for a diagnostics story
Higher regression risk for lifecycle gates
Would blur local diagnostics with completion semantics

options.name: C: Implement future server-backed proof workflow now
pros: Would eventually solve remote proof visibility more comprehensively
cons: Would delay the immediate UX fix

chosen: A: Add read-only summaries and runbook text around existing evaluators
rationale: Choose the diagnostic-only path because the bug is operator visibility, not a missing gate predicate. Existing evaluators already know enough facts; the fix should surface them clearly and preserve semantics.

preMortem.trigger: New all-runs or voluntary-round fields are named as if they satisfy DONE
preMortem.consequence: Operators may treat local diagnostics as stronger proof than they are
preMortem.mitigation: Use local diagnostic naming and keep authority/full/prod flags false in existing reports

preMortem.trigger: autopilot_review_status changes default output shape too aggressively
preMortem.consequence: Existing scripts expecting default-run summary break
preMortem.mitigation: Keep current fields and add summaries as additive data

preMortem.trigger: Failure formatter hardcodes vague commands without stale item context
preMortem.consequence: User still needs manual debugging after DONE blocks
preMortem.mitigation: Include stale verdict/evidence reason rows and exact recovery commands in smoke assertions
